messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 16 00}No! Nothing's wrong at all!{01 00 00 05 00}
And that's the problem!

{07 00 00}See, I like normal, unfancy
{04 11 00}, too! {01 00 00 05 00}It's
like we're exactly the same!
If we like all the same
things {07 0e 00}and we think all the
same things{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0f 00}How can we be sure we
aren't the same person?{01 01 00}
{07 00 00}I guess it doesn't matter.{03 01 00 01}{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 16 00}Ei! Midagi pole valesti!{01 00 00 05 00}
Ja see ongi probleem!

{07 00 00}Vaata, mulle meeldib ka
tavaline {04 11 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}Me
oleme nagu täpselt samad!
Kui meile meeldib kõik
sama {07 0e 00}ja me mõtleme kõike
sama{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0f 00}kuidas võime kindlad olla,
et me pole sama inimene?{01 01 00}
{07 00 00}Vist pole sel vahet.{03 01 00 01}{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 04 00}Yeah! What's wrong with
thinking the same thoughts,
anyway, {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}?
That just means we'll always
know we're not alone,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 01 00 01}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 04 00}Jah! Mis on halba samade
mõtete mõtlemises,
{ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}?
See tähendab lihtsalt, et
me teame alati, et me pole
üksi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 01 00 01}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 00 00}No, nothing like that. It's
just... I feel like you and
I have a lot in common.
You know what I do when I
feel really lonely,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Like on a rainy Sunday
afternoon {07 0b 00}when I can't even
change out of my pj's?
{07 00 00}That's when I talk to my
best friend in the whole
world.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0d 00}Moppina!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 00 00}Ei, midagi sellist. Lihtsalt
mulle tundub, et meil on
palju ühist.
Tead, mida ma teen, kui ma
end väga üksildasena
tunnen, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Näiteks vihmasel pühapäeva-
pärastlõunal, {07 0b 00}kui ma isegi
pidžaamat ei vaheta?
{07 00 00}Siis räägin ma oma parima
sõbraga terves
maailmas.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0d 00}Moppinaga!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 16 00}No, not that, {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!
The scary part is that I do
exactly the same thing!
{07 06 00}Doesn't it seem like a bit
too much of a coincidence
to you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 16 00}Ei, mitte see, {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!
Hirmus on see, et ma teen
täpselt sama asja!
{07 06 00}Kas see ei tundu sinu
meelest pisut liiga suur
juhus, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 00 00}No, I totally know what you
mean. The other day? This
guy comes up to me{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 16 00}And he starts telling me
all about his "secret ninja
training," {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}Like he's ever even SEEN a
real ninja! I mean, come ON!

{07 00 00}Is it wrong to want to be,
like, totally sane?{07 0b 00} What do
you think, {04 1f 00}?{09 01 00}{09 03 00}{09 02 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{09 09 00}{02 00 00 10 16}
Normal's fine.
Gimme ninjas!
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 00 00}Ei, ma saan täiesti aru,
mida sa mõtled. Hiljuti tuli
üks tüüp minu juurde{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 16 00}Ja ta hakkas mulle rääkima
oma „salajasest ninda-
treeningust”, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}Nagu ta oleks üldse päris
nindat NÄINUD! Ole nüüd!

{07 00 00}Kas on vale tahta olla
täiesti normaalne?{07 0b 00} Mida sa
arvad, {04 1f 00}?{09 01 00}{09 03 00}{09 02 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{09 09 00}{02 00 00 10 16}
Tavaline sobib.
Anna nindad!

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 05 00}{07 16 00}That's what everyone says!
Normal's always "fine" or
"good enough"! {01 00 00 05 00}Sheesh!
I'm tired of being fine!
I want to be fabulous,
just for once!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 05 00}{07 16 00}Nii ütlevad kõik!
Tavaline on alati „hea” või
„piisavalt hea”! {01 00 00 05 00}Pühh!
Olen tüdinud „heast”.
Ma tahan olla vapustav,
kas või korra!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 14 00}That's true. We might
complain about being too
normal, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
But at least we don't have
to worry about, like, our
worlds imploding on us.
I think we should just make
the best of our normal,
ninja-free lives.{03 01 00 01}{09 01 00}{03 01 00 01}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 14 00}See on tõsi. Me võime
nuriseda liiga tavalisuse
üle, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Aga vähemalt ei pea me
muretsema selle pärast, et
meie maailm kokku kukub.
Ma arvan, et me peaksime
lihtsalt nautima oma
tavalist, nindavaba elu.{03 01 00 01}{09 01 00}{03 01 00 01}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{09 04 00}I don't even know why we
bother asking you.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} You're
so predictably.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 09 00}weird.
{07 0f 00}Maybe I should just give in
to the madness, like all the
others around here!
{07 16 00}Maybe I should just run off
and become a roadie for
{ff 00 00 02}Iron Walrus{ff 00 00 00} or {ff 00 00 02}Hyppo{ff 00 00 00}!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{09 04 00}Ma ei tea isegi, miks me
sinult küsime.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Sa oled
nii etteaimatavalt.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 09 00}veider.
{07 0f 00}Ehk peaksin ma lihtsalt
hullusele alla andma, nagu
kõik teised siin!
{07 16 00}Ehk peaksin ma minema ja
hakkama abiliseks bändile
{ff 00 00 02}Iron Walrus{ff 00 00 00} või {ff 00 00 02}Hyppo{ff 00 00 00}!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 15 00}I see how it is with you,
{04 1f 00}! You people are
all the same, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{09 05 00}Don't let it get to you!
We're plenty interesting
just how we are!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 15 00}Ma näen, kuidas sinuga on,
{04 1f 00}! Teie olete kõik
ühesugused, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{09 05 00}Ära lase sel end häirida!
Me oleme küllalt huvitavad
nii, nagu oleme!{09 09 00}
